reference_pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks

source_run_manifest.interpretation: These are mechanically complete score outcomes only. Each has valid_full_game=false and is excluded from forecast comparisons because the batch validity gate accepted zero of 1000 requested seeds.

receiver_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

runner_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

model_reference.play_pool: nfl_pbp seasons 2022-2025 only; no 2026 outcome is in the pool

pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
pool_scope.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

simulation.regulation_score_policy: all runs whose simulation reached the regulation end, including ties and guarded regulation-end outcomes; descriptive, not validated finals
simulation.seed_rule: one deterministic game per consecutive non-negative integer seed
simulation.valid_score_policy: only valid_full_game=true, complete_game=true, untied outcomes; all other seeds remain in outcomes and coverage counts

configuration.overlap_rule: category A controls target-role label when available; playbook replaces C/D/E where supported

configuration.reason: coverage-conditioned outcome weights underpredict sacks on held-out plays

configuration.eligibility_rule: a rostered player listed Out or Doubtful on the frozen injury report is not eligible; Questionable and players with no report stay eligible; position-conditioned shares re-normalise within the selected eligible group

decision_evidence.decision: Keep the fourth-down action policy unchanged. Keep exact-yards-to-go yardage conditioning enabled to target the measured distance/chain-advancement path. Do not add a go-for-it multiplier. The replay predates V1.6, so this correction still needs full-game V1.6 validation.
decision_evidence.finding: The saved pre-V1.6 replay has a near-historical overall fourth-down rate, but excess 1-2-yard fourth-down states. It also has more third-down attempts, shorter third-down distances, higher third-down conversion, and more failed third-down gains that leave 1-2 yards.

fourth_down_opportunity_audit.interpretation: Total fourth-down states per drive were near historical levels (0.628 historical; 0.682-0.700 simulated). Fourth-and-1-to-2 states were higher (1.366 historical versus 1.75-2.10 simulated per team-game). The clearest measured contributor is the third-down distance/yardage chain: 1-5-yard third-down attempts and conversions are elevated, while more failed third-down plays leave 1-2 yards. Lower simulated sacks and turnovers may also prolong drives, but this replay did not isolate their contribution to fourth-and-short frequency.

limits: Only two matchups; the arms are not independent NFL-game samples.
This is a pre-V1.6 diagnostic and does not establish that V1.6 fixes the full-game distribution.
The saved replay does not isolate the causal contribution of short third-down state frequency, yardage outcomes, sacks, or turnovers.
prior_simulation_audit.source: SLC-v2 ordered-play replay; not generated by the V1.6 candidate

configuration.policy: mixture of exact-yards-to-go and distance-bucket source rows; bucket fallback below support

configuration.yardline_rule: exact yardline inside the 20 when source rows exist

configuration.policy: A/D/E are applied only after selecting a pass outcome; non-legacy modes use a strict penalty-clean source pool

configuration.precedence: replaces decision labels for C/D/E when the source cell has a playbook prior

configuration.conditioning: event type plus joint yards-bin and touchdown label; result sampled before state transition
configuration.source: nflverse nfl_pbp pass, rush, sack, completion and interception fields; participant keys are GSIS ids
configuration.transfer_rule: outcome observations are retained by stable player id; QB decision tendencies are separately keyed by team and QB
configuration.yardage_fallback: a missing role-specific player yard field omits that result adjustment; emitted box-score yards use yards_gained when the source field is null

configuration.qb_run_role_definition: primary-QB rush_attempt rows with play_type=run, excluding explicit scrambles, dropbacks, penalties and two-point attempts; qb_kneel rows are excluded by play_type. The residual can include QB sneaks because the source does not identify them separately.
configuration.qb_run_role_exposure: team run plays in games where the QB had the most recorded dropbacks; ties between primary passers are excluded
configuration.qb_run_role_style: player-versus-team log-odds adjustment to the team QB run-role prior, with 20-opportunity shrinkage

qb_sneak_classification.reason: the nfl_pbp table used by this fit has no qb_sneak field or play description, so sneaks cannot be separated in this model input

configuration.scramble_definition: qb_scramble among nflverse qb_dropback rows; scrambler identity uses rusher_player_id joined by GSIS id when its canonical position is QB
configuration.source: nfl_pbp qb_dropback, qb_scramble, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, penalty, two_point_attempt and play_type; canonical QB, rusher and receiver positions joined by GSIS id
configuration.transfer_rule: QB decision histories remain keyed by team and passer; a new team uses its team and league priors

configuration.rule: player-versus-team historical log-odds adjustment to the QB run-role share

configuration.overlap_rule: category A is sampled from the normalized geometric mean of team target-role and decision priors, renormalized to frozen eligible roles
